_about: Elsewhere Portal staging (M4.02) — config TEMPLATE. Every value is a named blank. Fill real values only in uncommitted local files / the Cloudflare dashboard; never commit a filled copy. The staging resources live on Atlas's own Cloudflare account (<agent-account-email>, Workers Free) — the agent-channel precedent account class, NOT the project owner's personal accounts.

deployToken._note: Deploys reuse the existing Cloudflare API token at ~/.config/cf-api-token (the agent-channel precedent). No new token is created for staging; no token value is ever written here.

site._customDomainNote: No custom domain and no DNS change under D7/D3 defaults. Adding one later is a separate the project owner-tier step.
site.pathToken: <GENERATE AT DEPLOY: 32+ random hex chars, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 24`. Set it as the Worker secret PORTAL_PATH_TOKEN (`wrangler secret put PORTAL_PATH_TOKEN`). It appears in the staging URL path and nowhere in this repo — the URL is the credential (D3 link-only).>
